public_rationale: Marcus forecast that AGI will eventually arrive, not soon, and only after new ideas replace the current LLM-scaling approach. He gave no deadline. As of October 2026 I found no system broadly accepted as AGI. A few industry figures have said AGI has arrived, but those claims are disputed and are not a consensus. With no AGI, there is nothing yet to show whether it came, when, or by what methods. The forecast stays open.
limitations: AGI has no agreed definition, so any future ruling will turn on interpretation.
'Not soon' is undated, which makes the timing part hard to score.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AGI will eventually arrive but not soon, and will require new ideas because the field's current hypothesis has basically been disproven.
conditions: requires new ideas beyond the current scaling hypothesis

statement.excerpt: I always say that AGI will come, just not soon, and in fact said so explicitly in emails to Newton yesterday (e.g., “we will get to AGI, but the field has been pursuing a hypothesis that was basically (just as I anticipated) disproven, so we will need new ideas.”)
statement.document_title: Hard-forked! Casey Newton’s distorted portrait of Gary Marcus and AI skepticism

from_speaker: the field has been pursuing a hypothesis that was basically ... disproven
our_interpretation: The forecast is that AGI will eventually arrive, not soon, and only through ideas beyond the current LLM-scaling approach.
The claim about what he 'always says' and wrote in emails is about his own views. It is not scored here.
'Not soon' has no stated date. I treat the forecast as having no deadline.
Plain reading of AGI: a system that the research community broadly accepts as general intelligence at roughly human level. A claim by one company's executive is not enough.
criteria.support_condition: A system broadly accepted as AGI appears after a period an ordinary reader would not call 'soon', and it clearly depends on new ideas beyond scaling LLMs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A system broadly accepted as AGI appears soon after December 2024 and mainly by scaling the LLM approach, or it becomes clear that AGI cannot be built at all.
